tagline.zh-CN: 你的 AI 工程剧团

note.en: Human. Signs the command deck. Does not work the floor.
note.zh-CN: 人类。指挥台署名。不在场上干活。

task.zh-CN: 把今天的看板维持诚实

task.en: Label the seven deferred backlog items
task.zh-CN: 给延后的 7 条需求打上标签

duty.en: P1–P6 plan and the risk list

task.en: Brief assumption A3 for the chairman
task.zh-CN: 整理假设 A3，待董事长确认

output.en: Risk list updated, two open items
output.zh-CN: 风险清单已更新，仍有两件未决

task.zh-CN: 为 ADR-001 补模块边界备注

duty.en: Test plan, cases, and the quality gate
duty.zh-CN: 测试计划、用例、质量门禁

task.zh-CN: 把 40 条用例追回需求

output.zh-CN: 测试计划成稿，40 条用例
第二轮视觉意见已关闭

task.en: Check the frozen Write + Manage scope
task.zh-CN: 核对已冻结的「写 + 管」范围

summary.en: 35 items. 28 are P0. The pool lives here.
summary.zh-CN: 35 条需求，其中 P0 28 条。池子在这里。

summary.en: ADR-001 Module split is the asset on this desk.
summary.zh-CN: 这张桌上的资产是 ADR-001《模块划分》。

summary.en: Three reviewers, two rounds, 39 of 39 comments closed.
summary.zh-CN: 三位评审官，两轮，39/39 条意见全部闭环。

summary.en: No resident engineer. Work arrives as chips.
summary.zh-CN: 没有常驻工程师。活以芯片形式流进来。

summary.en: 40 cases planned. They have not been executed.
summary.zh-CN: 40 条用例在计划层。还没有执行。

summary.en: The gate opens only after the chairman signs.
summary.zh-CN: 董事长敲定通过，闸门才开。

summary.en: Lead Agent on the dais. Project Manager on the flank. Signed by the Chairman.
summary.zh-CN: 主Agent 在高台。项目经理在侧翼。董事长署名。

todos.en: Assumption A3 is waiting on the chairman
todos.zh-CN: 项目经理假设 A3 待董事长确认

todos.en: The paper GitHub repo is not created yet

title.zh-CN: MVP 范围冻结：写 + 管

reviewAgenda.en: P1 planning pack: scope sentence, backlog split, ADR-001, Android-first path.
reviewAgenda.zh-CN: P1 规划包：范围句子、需求拆分、ADR-001、Android 先行路径。

line.en: Today we close the P1 planning pack. Scope stays frozen.
line.zh-CN: 今天只收 P1 规划包。范围不放。

line.en: Thirty-five in the pool. Twenty-eight P0s are aligned. The other seven sit past P2.
line.zh-CN: 池子里 35 条。P0 的 28 条对齐了。另外 7 条放到 P2 之后。

line.en: Assumption A3 is still with the chairman. The paper repo does not exist yet.
line.zh-CN: 假设 A3 还在董事长那儿。paper 仓库到现在还没建。

line.en: ADR-001 again: editor, preview, vault, shell. Nobody reaches into anyone else.
line.zh-CN: ADR-001 再念一遍：编辑、预览、文库、壳。谁也不许伸手进别人的模块。

line.en: Forty cases are a plan. We will not talk as if they already ran.
line.zh-CN: 40 条用例还是计划。别说得好像已经测过。

line.en: Friday note: still on P1. Reviews 39/39. Blocked on A3 and the paper repo. No new red-line risk.
line.zh-CN: 周五纪要：还在 P1。评审 39/39。卡在 A3 和 paper 仓库。没有新的红线风险。

text.en: Case 12 lets preview read editor internals. That breaks ADR-001. Assert on the public render only.
text.zh-CN: 用例 12 让预览去读编辑器内部状态，这破了 ADR-001。只断言公开渲染结果。

outcome.en: Settled. QA asserts the public render. Architect adds one ADR note tonight.
outcome.zh-CN: 说定了。测试只断言公开渲染结果。架构师今晚补一句 ADR 备注。

summary.en: P1 pack: Write + Manage, option C, ADR-001, reviews 39/39. Requesting the chairman's decision.
summary.zh-CN: P1 包：写 + 管、选项 C、ADR-001、评审 39/39。请董事长敲定。

present.en: Lead Agent presents the pack to the chairman.
present.zh-CN: 主Agent 把包呈到董事长面前。

approved.en: Chairman signs it through. The release gate may open.
approved.zh-CN: 董事长敲定通过。发布闸门可以开。

rejected.en: Chairman sends it back. The gate stays shut.

scoreSummary.en: Lead Agent files the two-way scores and the peer review to the chairman.
scoreSummary.zh-CN: 主Agent 把双向打分和小领导互评汇总，呈给董事长。

action.en: Preview crash reproduced. It blocks tonight's planning close.
action.zh-CN: 预览崩溃复现了，堵住今晚的规划收口。

action.en: Someone added sync out loud. The frozen MVP just got hit.
action.zh-CN: 有人嘴里把同步加回来了。冻结的 MVP 被冲了一下。

text.en: Editor canvas contrast is too shy on white. Body text disappears beside the caret.
text.zh-CN: 白底上编辑区对比不够。正文挨着光标就淡了。

resolution.en: Body ink locked to #1c2430 on #fbfbfa. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 正文定成 #1c2430 / 底 #fbfbfa。关闭。

text.en: Heading scale is unnamed. H1 and H2 are the same weight in the spec.
text.zh-CN: 标题阶梯没名字。规范里 H1 和 H2 一样重。

resolution.en: Four steps only: 28 / 22 / 18 / 16. Closed.

text.en: Toolbar icons mix 1.5px and 2px strokes.
text.zh-CN: 工具栏图标线宽有的 1.5，有的 2，不齐。

resolution.en: All toolbar icons are 24px, 1.75 stroke. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 工具栏统一 24px、线宽 1.75。关闭。

text.en: The editor/preview split has no default ratio.
text.zh-CN: 编辑和预览的分割，没有默认比例。

resolution.en: Preview opens at 42%. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 预览默认 42%。关闭。

text.en: Empty library wants an illustration. That fights the minimal brief.
text.zh-CN: 空文库想加插画。这跟极简立项是反的。

resolution.en: Empty state is one sentence, no illustration. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 空状态只留一句话，不加插画。关闭。

text.en: File rows are too tall for a phone library.
text.zh-CN: 文件行太高，手机上的文库塞不下。

resolution.en: Row height 56, title plus one meta line. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 行高 56，标题加一行元信息。关闭。

text.en: Dark theme keeps leaking into MVP mockups.
text.zh-CN: 深色主题老是漏进 MVP 稿里。

resolution.en: Dark theme is out of MVP. Mocks updated. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 深色主题不进 MVP。稿已改。关闭。

text.en: Sync still has a nav slot. The scope sentence says Write + Manage only.
text.zh-CN: 导航里还有同步入口。范围句子只允许写和管。

resolution.en: Sync removed from navigation. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 同步已从导航拿掉。关闭。

text.en: 35 items vs 28 P0s is unexplained on the roadmap.
text.zh-CN: 路线图上 35 和 P0 的 28 对不上，没解释。

resolution.en: The other 7 are labeled deferred, past P2. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 另外 7 条标明延后，放到 P2 之后。关闭。

text.en: Markor's raw UI is the reason we exist, but pains are not tied to ids.
text.zh-CN: 我们是因为 Markor 界面太糙才立项的，痛点却没挂到编号上。

resolution.en: Pains map to R-01 through R-35. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 痛点映射到 R-01 至 R-35。关闭。

text.en: Export is neither in nor out. That will get built by accident.
text.zh-CN: 导出既没写进范围，也没写出去。这种会被顺手做出来。

resolution.en: Export is explicitly out of MVP. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 导出明确不进 MVP。关闭。

text.en: Folders and tags are both drawn. Pick one for v1.
text.zh-CN: 文件夹和标签都画了。v1 只能留一个。

resolution.en: Folders only. Tags are out. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 只留文件夹。标签不做。关闭。

text.en: Is search part of Manage, or a later idea?
text.zh-CN: 搜索算「管」，还是以后再说？

resolution.en: Search is in Manage. Title and body. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 搜索算「管」。标题和正文。关闭。

text.en: Editor scroll and preview scroll are unspecified.
text.zh-CN: 编辑滚动和预览滚动怎么跟，没写。

resolution.en: Sync on by default, with a disconnect. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 默认跟随，允许断开。关闭。

text.en: Android back vs the library drawer will fight.
text.zh-CN: Android 返回键和文库抽屉会打架。

resolution.en: Back closes the drawer first, then leaves the note. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 返回先关抽屉，再退出笔记。关闭。

text.en: Undo depth is missing. Writers will notice on the first mistake.
text.zh-CN: 撤销深度没写。写的人第一次写错就会发现。

resolution.en: Undo stack is 50 steps. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 撤销栈 50 步。关闭。

text.en: Shortcut map is desktop-shaped. Android is the first ship.
text.zh-CN: 快捷键表是桌面形状的。我们先上船的是 Android。

resolution.en: Touch first. Shortcuts wait. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 先触摸。快捷键以后。关闭。

text.en: Multi-file delete has no confirm. One thumb will erase a folder.
text.zh-CN: 多文件删除没有确认。拇指一下就能清掉一个文件夹。

resolution.en: Confirm only when more than one file is selected. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 只在选中多个文件时确认。关闭。

text.en: Focus order in the editor toolbar is undesigned.
text.zh-CN: 编辑器工具栏的焦点顺序没人管。

resolution.en: Focus ring spec added, left to right, then canvas. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 补了焦点环：从左到右，再到画布。关闭。

text.en: Preview is sketched calling editor private state. That is not a module boundary.
text.zh-CN: 稿子里预览直接调编辑器私有状态。这不叫模块边界。

resolution.en: Preview reads the public render snapshot only. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 预览只读公开渲染快照。关闭。

text.en: H1 at 28 still collides with the status bar on small phones.
text.zh-CN: H1 用 28，小手机上会撞状态栏。

resolution.en: H1 steps down to 24 under 360px width. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 宽度低于 360 时 H1 降到 24。关闭。

text.en: The 1.75 stroke looks light on the teal accent icons.
text.zh-CN: 青色强调图标上，1.75 的线还是偏轻。

resolution.en: Accent icons use the same stroke. Color carries the weight. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 强调图标线宽不变。靠颜色提重。关闭。

text.en: 42% preview feels cramped once the keyboard is open.
text.zh-CN: 键盘弹起来之后，42% 的预览太挤。

resolution.en: Keyboard open collapses preview to a tab. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 键盘弹出时预览收成一个标签。关闭。

text.en: The empty-state sentence is centered like a marketing page.
text.zh-CN: 空状态那句话居中了，像营销页。

resolution.en: Left aligned, same inset as file rows. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 左对齐，和文件行同一缩进。关闭。

text.en: Deferred items still appear in the P0 count on one slide.
text.zh-CN: 有一页幻灯还把延后项算进了 P0。

resolution.en: Slide corrected. P0 is 28. Total is 35. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 那页改了。P0 是 28。总数 35。关闭。

text.en: R-14 has no acceptance line.
text.zh-CN: R-14 没有验收句。

resolution.en: Acceptance line added: create, rename, delete a folder. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 补了验收句：新建、重命名、删除文件夹。关闭。

text.en: Share-sheet copy still says export in the Android notes.
text.zh-CN: Android 备注里，分享面板的文案还在说导出。

resolution.en: Share sheet removed from the P1 pack. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 分享面板已从 P1 包里删掉。关闭。

text.en: A tag chip survived in the file-row mock.
text.zh-CN: 文件行稿子里还留着一枚标签芯片。

resolution.en: Chip deleted. Folders only. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 芯片删了。只留文件夹。关闭。

text.en: Search placeholder promises semantic search. We cannot build that.
text.zh-CN: 搜索占位符承诺了语义搜索。我们做不了那个。

resolution.en: Placeholder now says title and body only. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 占位符改成只搜标题和正文。关闭。

text.en: Scroll sync fights manual preview scrolling.
text.zh-CN: 滚动跟随会跟手动翻预览对着干。

resolution.en: A manual preview scroll breaks sync until the next edit. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 手动翻预览就断开跟随，直到下一次编辑。关闭。

text.en: Predictive back on Android 14 is not mentioned.
text.zh-CN: Android 14 的预测性返回没提。

resolution.en: Option C note: predictive back closes the drawer. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 选项 C 备注：预测性返回先关抽屉。关闭。

text.en: Undo across notes would surprise people.
text.zh-CN: 撤销如果跨笔记，会吓到人。

resolution.en: Undo is per note. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 撤销按笔记隔离。关闭。

text.en: Long-press on a file has no stated outcome.
text.zh-CN: 长按文件会怎样，没写。

resolution.en: Long-press selects. A second tap opens. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 长按是选中。再点一次才打开。关闭。

text.en: Single-file delete confirm was removed, but the trash affordance is unclear.
text.zh-CN: 单文件删除不确认了，可是垃圾桶长什么样没说清。

resolution.en: Trash is a row action with undo snackbar, 5 seconds. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 删除是行内操作，5 秒撤销条。关闭。

text.en: Focus ring color is the same as the caret. They merge.
text.zh-CN: 焦点环和光标一个颜色，糊在一起。

resolution.en: Ring is #2f6fed. Caret stays ink. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 焦点环用 #2f6fed。光标仍是墨色。关闭。

text.en: Accent tokens are not written down, so the next mock will drift.
text.zh-CN: 强调色没落成 token，下一稿还会漂。

resolution.en: Ink, paper, and accent tokens added to ADR-001 appendix. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 墨色、纸色、强调色 token 写进 ADR-001 附录。关闭。

text.en: The 40 cases do not name which requirement they cover.
text.zh-CN: 40 条用例没写各自覆盖哪条需求。

resolution.en: Trace column added. Every case points at an R-id. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 加了追溯列。每条用例指向一个 R 编号。关闭。

text.en: The scope sentence still has a soft 'for now' in the Chinese pack.
text.zh-CN: 中文包里的范围句子还带着「先这样」。

resolution.en: Both languages now say the scope is frozen: Write + Manage. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 两种语言都改成范围已冻结：写 + 管。关闭。

text.en: Option C does not say what the back stack contains.
text.zh-CN: 选项 C 没写返回栈里到底有什么。

resolution.en: Stack is library, then note. Nothing else in MVP. Closed.
resolution.zh-CN: 栈里只有文库，然后是笔记。MVP 别无其他。关闭。
